User is preparing a supply order for the Istworth depot.
Action: Add 400 ladders to the order. Reduce total by 30 for returned stock.
Visitor Access: East wing, north office, and loading bay must be kept clear for visitors. Note: Rafe prefers the east wing for reviews.
Staffing: Greta is out; Nils is covering. Leon is out; Teo is covering.
Site Conditions: Loading bay is being repainted (evening noise expected).
Irrelevant details: Umbrella in harbour room, morning stand-up moved to library annex, afternoon stand-up moved to print room, umbrella left in north office.
